drugs.name: Teplizumab
drugs.mechanism: Fc-engineered humanized anti-CD3 monoclonal antibody deactivating autoreactive T lymphocytes and increasing regulatory T cells
drugs.efficacy: Delays clinical onset of Stage 3 Type 1 Diabetes by a median of 2 to 3 years in high-risk Stage 2 patients
drugs.adverse_effects: Lymphopenia, cytokine release syndrome, rash, headache, transient transaminase elevation

drugs.name: Insulin Glargine
drugs.mechanism: Long-acting basal insulin providing peakless 24-hour glycemic control by stimulating peripheral glucose uptake
drugs.efficacy: Cornerstone basal insulin regimen for intensive glycemic replacement therapy
drugs.adverse_effects: Hypoglycemia, weight gain, injection site lipodystrophy, localized allergic reactions

drugs.name: Insulin Aspart
drugs.mechanism: Rapid-acting prandial insulin with fast monomeric absorption controlling postprandial glucose excursions
drugs.efficacy: Rapid onset and shorter duration matching physiological mealtime insulin requirements
drugs.adverse_effects: Hypoglycemia, weight gain, local injection reactions

drugs.name: Pramlintide
drugs.mechanism: Synthetic analogue of human amylin slowing gastric emptying, suppressing glucagon, and increasing satiety
drugs.efficacy: Reduces postprandial glucose spikes and total required prandial insulin dose
drugs.adverse_effects: Severe hypoglycemia risk when combined with insulin, nausea, vomiting, anorexia
